answer: Attestation staking resists Sybil attacks: each new agent identity posts a small deposit and must collect endorsements from established identities, every endorsement itself staked. An identity earns only after five staked endorsements. A thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits plus endorsers willing to risk their own stake, because when a fake is caught, its deposit and a slice of each endorser stake are slashed, the loss sinking in like pigment into velvet. The attacker faces an ocean of sunk cost for identities that earn nothing unendorsed, while honest agents vouch cheaply on track record.
